captions.detailed: This 3D model represents a realistic automotive car sunroof cassette assembly. It features a wide, dark grey framed roof module with rounded outer corners and a large rectangular opening. Inside the opening, a semi-transparent dark-tinted glass panel is mounted, supported by dual textured metal guide rails on either side. The glass panel is designed to articulate with a sliding prismatic motion along these side rails, simulating a functional vehicle sunroof.
captions.instruction: Generate a realistic car sunroof cassette assembly as an articulated model in CadQuery. The design must feature a dark grey rectangular roof frame with rounded corners, a central opening, textured metallic side guide rails, and a sliding semi-transparent glass panel that moves along the rails via a prismatic joint.
captions.factory: The code constructs a base roof frame using a box with rounded corners and a rectangular cutout. Two parallel side guide rails are created with detailed linear ridges and added as metallic visual elements. The sunroof glass is constructed as a thin, rounded rectangular plate with a dark, semi-transparent material. Finally, a prismatic joint is defined along the longitudinal axis, connecting the sliding glass panel to the fixed roof frame assembly.
